text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: And with that, the hilling is all done.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Phew... that was a good warm-up. Let's 
take a quick breather.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
The weather's so nice, and the breeze 
feels great...

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
The sun... so warm... the smell... of 
soil...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Nishino Flower ended up falling asleep 
right then and there, skipping out on her 
training.
